newsitem.title: USA: Sharon Energy has California gas field find.
newsitem.headline: Sharon Energy has California gas field find.

text.p: Sharon Energy Ltd said on Wednesday that its Knight Ranch 1-A well in its Merlin Prospect has made a new natural gas field discovery.
The well is located in Glenn County, Calif.

Based on drilling and electric logs two zones have been identified for completion -- one in the Kione at 3,800 feet and one in the upper Forbes at 4,300 feet. Production casing was being set Wednesday and completion operations are scheduled to take place within the next two weeks.

Sharon said drilling operations will start on Thursday on the second well in the Merlin Prospect, the Henning-Loshe 1, where 3-D seismic has predicted two potential pay zones in the Forbes. The well is projected to a depth 5,600 feet.

The Merlin Prospect is part of Sharon's Malton-Willows Joint Venture with Hallador Petroleum Co and Black Coral LLC, both of Denver. Sharon is the venture's operator and has retained a 40 percent working interest.
